brief:
Israeli occupation forces continued uprooting olive trees and bulldozing agricultural land in the village of Deir Ballut in Salfit district, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation targeted multiple Palestinian-owned agricultural plots in the area, destroying crops and rendering portions of land unworkable.

The demolition follows a pattern of land seizures in the occupied West Bank, where Palestinian farmers have reported repeated losses of orchards and fields to Israeli military operations. Residents of Deir Ballut said the destruction affected productive olive groves that had supplied income to several families in the village.
title: Israeli forces uproot olive trees, bulldoze land in Deir Ballut
